name: Kusuda Tomohiko
source: Husband of Misa and father of Tomomi. He loves his wife and daughter but recently he felt that his daughter has been cold towards him.So he uses a health device from work to bring out his daughter hidden feelings towards him but in the process brings out his hidden feelings for his daughter as well.
